title: Rhombus_Botnet_Investigation_2af
description: Investigate and respond to unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and respond to these issues. The investigation focuses on the Rhombus botnet family, known for its periodic external communication patterns and persistence mechanisms.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that communicates with an external host?
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for unusual or recently created services. The suspicious service is likely named 'bot-beacon.service'. The flag is the name of a systemd service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for unusual or recently created services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to network communication or health checks.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the name of the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Investigate systemd timers and services related to the suspicious service identified in the previous task. The persistence mechanism is likely a systemd timer named 'bot-beacon.timer'. The flag is the name of a systemd timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate systemd timers and services related to the suspicious service identified in the previous task.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for timers that trigger the suspicious service.

levels.title: Identify Command-and-Control Server
levels.content:
Determine the external host communicating with the compromised system.

**Question:** What is the IP address of the command-and-control server?
levels.solution: Examine the network connections and logs of the suspicious service to identify the external host. The command-and-control server is likely at IP address 192.168.70.5. The flag is an IP address.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the network connections and logs of the suspicious service to identify the external host.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the logs in /var/lib/.botcache/beacon.log for connections to external hosts.
